args.command: export DISPLAY=:0; echo '=== before ==='; wmctrl -l -x || true; id=$(wmctrl -l -x | awk 'tolower($0) ~ /google-chrome/ {print $1; exit}'); if [ -n "$id" ]; then wmctrl -ic "$id"; fi; sleep 3; echo '=== after ==='; wmctrl -l -x || true; systemctl show zen-mini-chrome.service -p Restart -p ActiveState 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'TASKBAR='$(systemctl is-active zen-mini-taskbar.service 2>/dev/null || true); chvt 3 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Close the exact Chrome window now that auto-restart is disabled
